name: folio
description: Magazine-style presentation skill that turns structured content into editable decks across HTML, PPTX, PDF, Figma, and IDML.
release_highlights: Added a formal bleed/trim/safe/content line system to the Reference Layout preview sheet.
Added five required bleed modes: no-bleed, soft-bleed, edge-bleed, full-bleed, and print-bleed.
Updated Folio layout contracts and reference-template docs so every page declares how images relate to bleed, trim, safe, and content boundaries.
